title: Comparing Weaning of Nasal Continuous Positive Airway Pressure (CPAP) From Preterm Infants
brief_summary: To compare the 2 methods of weaning of nasal continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) in premature babies born between 26 and 32 weeks
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All neonates born 26 to 32 weeks of gestational age

Exclusion Criteria:

* Those with severe congenital anomalies and chromosomal defects including congenital heart disease, neurological malformations, chest and airway abnormalities and lung hypoplasia
